about: Kit parts that carry a component from the ARCS OS Design System (claude.ai/artifact/1DnaMvAFvSspGFTvh1f2wi, components/bundle.js). Each listed declaration must appear in the part's @prim block, so the kit cannot drift from the design system again. Checked by scripts/kit_primitive_sync.py --kit. Seams settled by Zach (2026-11-13): the Badge's 4px radius joins the scale as --ds-r-badge (each use carries a 4px fallback for pages whose inlined token block predates it). The Badge's 10px text stays at the repo's 11px functional floor (--fs-label): the legibility check blocked 10px on counterpart pages, and Zach kept 11px. The 22px height is the outer height (border-box), as the design system renders it.
